caption: The drawing depicts a brown elephant standing on a large black and red cylindrical pedestal. The elephant is draped with a red cloth that has gold fringe and tassels. On top of the elephant, there is a small human figure dressed in blue, wearing a conical hat and standing on one leg with the other leg bent at the knee. To the left of the pedestal, there is a set of black and yellow stairs. At the bottom of the stairs, a kneeling human figure in red and tan clothing is posed with both arms extended forward. At the top of the stairs, another human figure, dressed in tan, holds a large brown sphere above their head. On the right side of the pedestal, another human figure dressed in red and blue is shown standing and bending backward, holding a gold ring above their head. The background is a plain, off-white color. The composition is arranged so that the elephant is central and elevated, while the human figures interact with the stairs, sphere, and ring surrounding the pedestal. The artist’s signature, "Frank H. Gray," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Elephant
